<template>
  <v-card class="tile-sw0" :style="{ backgroundColor: active ? '#1565c0' : '#424242', border: '3px solid #1565c0' }">
    <v-icon size="32" :class="active ? 'icon-on-sw0' : 'icon-off-sw0'">mdi-button-pointer</v-icon>
  </v-card>
</template>
<script>
  export default {
  data() { return { active: false } },
  watch: {
    msg(m) {
      if (!m || m.payload === undefined) return;
      this.active = m.payload === true || m.payload === 'true' || m.payload === 1;
    }
  }
}
</script>
<style scoped>
  .tile-sw0 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    transition: background-color 0.3s;
  }

  .icon-off-sw0 :deep(.v-icon__svg) {
    fill: #757575 !important;
  }

  .icon-on-sw0 :deep(.v-icon__svg) {
    fill: #ffffff !important;
  }
</style>

name: led
format:
<template>
  <v-card class="tile-led" :style="{ backgroundColor: active ? '#f9a825' : '#424242', border: '3px solid #f9a825' }"
    @click="toggle">
    <v-icon size="32" :class="active ? 'icon-on-led' : 'icon-off-led'">
      {{ active ? 'mdi-led-on' : 'mdi-led-off' }}
    </v-icon>
  </v-card>
</template>
<script>
  export default {
  data() { return { active: false } },
  watch: {
    msg(m) {
      if (!m || m.payload === undefined) return;
      this.active = m.payload === true || m.payload === 'true' || m.payload === 1;
    }
  },
  methods: {
    toggle() {
      this.active = !this.active;
      this.send({ payload: this.active });
    }
  }
}
</script>
<style scoped>
  .tile-led {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    transition: background-color 0.3s;
  }

  .icon-off-led :deep(.v-icon__svg) {
    fill: #757575 !important;
  }

  .icon-on-led :deep(.v-icon__svg) {
    fill: #b71c1c !important;
  }
</style>
